title: Converting to Radians
text: In order to plug the values into the formula, you will need to convert degrees into radians. What do you get when you divide the degrees by $$180$$ degrees and multiply by pi?

title: Formula of Area
text: Use A $$=$$ $$\frac{\theta}{360} \pi r^2$$ when theta is in degrees, or A $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta$$ when theta is in radians. Here theta $$=$$ $$\frac{\pi}{4}$$, so calculate the area of the sector.

title: Simplify
text: Simplify the expression and multiply by the decimal value of pi $$(3.14)$$ to get the final answer.
